Lagos, Ogun, Abia or Anambra, Nigeria
Contracted
Entry Level

Job Summary
The BD Associate will be responsible for identifying and onboarding business owners (merchants) to use Flexi MFB’s Pay With Transfer solution. This is a field-based role that requires daily engagement with customers.

Key Responsibilities
• Approach and engage business owners in markets and commercial areas
• Educate customers on the benefits of Pay With Transfer (PWT). Prior experience not required, training will be provided.
• Onboard and assist merchants in opening business accounts
• Meet daily and weekly onboarding targets

Requirements
• No prior experience required (training will be provided)
• Immediate resumption is prioritized.
• Must reside in Lagos, Ogun, Abia or Anambra
• Good communication and interpersonal skills
• Energetic, confident, and target-driven
